projects.name: Lido
projects.description: Dominant liquid staking protocol. Users stake ETH → receive stETH (rebasing token that accrues staking rewards). $14.84B TVL, ~50% LST market share. Essential DeFi infrastructure.
bull_case: Dominant LST with 50% market share — monopoly-level position
FDV/TVL of 0.015 is absurdly low — deeply undervalued
stETH is the most composable asset in DeFi — used everywhere
$100M+ annual revenue from real yield (not emissions)
DVT integration addresses centralization concerns
bear_case: 50% staking share is a systemic risk
LDO token doesn't directly accrue revenue (governance only)
Regulatory risk: LSTs may be classified as securities
Competition from Rocket Pool, Coinbase cbETH

projects.name: Aave
projects.description: Largest decentralized lending protocol. $12.30B TVL across 10+ chains. Omnichain expansion with GHO stablecoin. AAVE Safety Module captures protocol fees.
bull_case: Dominant lending protocol with $12.30B TVL across 10+ chains
GHO stablecoin creates internal demand and revenue
AAVE Safety Module directly captures protocol fees
Best-in-class security track record (no major exploits)
Omnichain strategy positions Aave as the lending layer of all chains
bear_case: Morpho is competing with peer-to-peer matching
TVL spread across 10+ chains dilutes focus
GHO is small vs. USDC/USDT — needs to scale 10x
Smart contract risk increases with each new chain

projects.name: Sky (Maker)
projects.description: RWA-backed stablecoin protocol (formerly MakerDAO). USDS stablecoin backed by ETH + US Treasury bills. DSR offers ~5-8% yield from real assets. $6.03B TVL.
bull_case: RWA-backed stablecoin is a genuine innovation
DSR yield (~5-8%) attracts capital in all market conditions
USDS is censorship-resistant (unlike USDC)
Battle-tested protocol (since 2017) with no major exploits
Real revenue from real assets
bear_case: RWA concentration: if US Treasury yields drop, DSR yield drops
Regulatory risk: RWA protocols are a clear target
Rebrand from Maker → Sky confused the community
Competition from Ethena (USDe) in synthetic dollar space

projects.name: Pendle
projects.description: Yield tokenization protocol. Splits yield-bearing assets into PT (principal) and YT (yield) tokens. $1.17B TVL. Category leader in a genuinely new DeFi primitive.
bull_case: Yield tokenization is a genuinely new primitive — category leader
Integration with Ethena (sUSDe) created a powerful flywheel
vePENDLE model aligns long-term holders
As more yield-bearing assets emerge, Pendle's TAM grows
Fee sharing is improving token value accrual
bear_case: Complex product — most users don't understand PT/YT mechanics
TVL is concentrated in a few pools (sUSDe, stETH)
If yield rates decline, less incentive to tokenize
-21% 30d TVL decline is concerning

projects.name: Ethena
projects.description: Synthetic dollar (USDe) backed by delta-neutral strategy: long ETH staking + short perps. $4.84B TVL. Yield depends on perpetual funding rates staying positive.
bull_case: $4.84B TVL in 1.5 years — explosive growth
Real yield from funding rates (not emissions)
Delta-neutral strategy is elegant and scalable
USDe is censorship-resistant (unlike USDC)
Integration with Pendle (sUSDe) creates powerful DeFi primitive
bear_case: Funding rate risk: if perps go negative, USDe yield = 0%
Relies on CEXs (Binance, Bybit) for hedging — centralization
Regulatory: synthetic dollars are a clear target
ENA token has no fee sharing, heavy emissions

projects.name: Rocket Pool
projects.description: Decentralized liquid staking protocol. Only truly decentralized LST — anyone can run a validator with 8 ETH. $0.89B TVL, ~3% market share. RPL is deeply undervalued (FDV/TVL 0.04).
bull_case: Only truly decentralized LST — critical for Ethereum's health
RPL is deeply undervalued (FDV/TVL 0.04)
DVT adoption could scale without sacrificing decentralization
Battle-tested, no exploits, strong community
If Lido faces regulatory action, Rocket Pool is the natural beneficiary
bear_case: 3% market share vs. Lido's 50% — the gap is widening
rETH liquidity is thin — high slippage for large trades
RPL token emissions are inflationary (no buyback)
-26.3% 30d TVL decline suggests outflows

projects.name: EigenLayer
projects.description: Restaking infrastructure — ETH stakers opt-in to secure additional services (AVS). $4.64B TVL but -36.7% 30d decline. AVS marketplace is early and unproven.
bull_case: Restaking is a genuinely new primitive — powerful if AVS matures
$4.64B TVL (even after decline) shows real demand
First-mover advantage in restaking — no direct competitor at scale
If AVS adoption accelerates, EigenLayer becomes critical infrastructure
EIGEN is cheap (MCap $132M) if the thesis plays out
bear_case: -36.7% 30d TVL decline — capital is leaving
AVS ecosystem is mostly points farming — not real demand
EIGEN token has no fee sharing — pure governance token
Heavy token unlocks ahead — sell pressure
If AVS adoption doesn't accelerate, becomes an expensive experiment
